checks.guidance: Check finite nonempty meshes, unique attachment slots, valid primitives and semantic ownership before detailing.
Keep all expected attached components under their semantic owner; check relative transforms and non-target preservation under the prescribed move.
Resolve target mesh descendants; copy shared materials for local changes; preserve non-target matrices, vertices, parents and material nodes.

plan.instruction: Improve shared H using supplied evidence only. Recover build/output failures before visual diagnosis. Use controlled results as scope-limited sensitivity evidence, never causal attribution from one delta. Review camera against multiple anchors, object scale at its semantic owner, actual support surfaces, and construction versus occlusion for missing items. Keep measured facts, visual hypotheses and historical heuristics separate. Preserve local material non-target state and composite movement. Unknown mappings stay unknown. Do not modify SceneAct, model roles, evaluator, objectives, acceptance, splits or resource limits. Return reusable H, not a patched per-scene generator.
